T2-C09 owns the pre-fit evidence chain: R1 AA prereg signature; R2 browser PDF downloads, MUST, deadline 10 Nov, Kush about 1 h; R3 CAL extraction 11-12 Nov with R-SCI's partition rule for any AAK-X addition; R4 dual blind verification, 3 h each, by 15 Nov, with R-SCI's process-based acceptance.
